algorithm.cca_method: center by train score means; covariances with 1/(n-1); optional ridge on Sxx/Syy; symmetric inverse sqrt via eigh with relative eigenvalue floor; SVD of whitened cross-covariance; B = Sxx^{-1/2} U_r diag(rho_r) V_r^T Syy^{1/2}; all float64
algorithm.covariance_strategy: full-size Sxx (10592x10592), Sxy (10592x1024), Syy (1024x1024) computed once from centered train scores; every grid row slices the leading Kx/Ky blocks (truncated score means are prefixes of the full means)
algorithm.row_evaluation_caching: X whitener cached per (Kx, alpha), Y whitener per (Ky, alpha), whitened cross-covariance SVD per (Kx, Ky, alpha); all valid r for a fixed (Kx, Ky, alpha) truncate the same decomposition. eigh/svd are deterministic on identical inputs, so results are bit-identical to refitting every row; only redundant recomputation is removed. Same formulas, same eig_floor_rel, ridge unchanged at [0.0].

grid_valid_rule: r <= min(Kx, Ky); no unplanned selectable rows may be added to this config
intended_outputs_note: All Stage 03 production outputs are small (largest: selected_cca_model.npz, B is at most 10592x1024 float64 ~ 87 MB) and live under home outputs/cca_grid/. No production scratch outputs are used, so heavy_artifact_manifest_json is null. Smoke outputs go to smoke_output_root on scratch.

metric.mse_normalization: SSE / (n_samples * n_pixels); Stage 01 area weights are normalized to mean 1
metric.name: full-field area-weighted residual-correction MSE/RMSE (K^2 / K)
metric.skill: 1 - mse_model / mse_bilinear, where mse_bilinear is the exact area-weighted MSE of the raw (uncentered) residual field
metric.sse_identity: SSE = C_centered + sum(yhat^2) - 2*sum(yhat*y_true_retained), exact because the Stage 01 Y EOFs are weighted-space orthonormal and Stage 02 Y scores are the coordinates of the centered residual in that basis
metric.train_constants_source: Stage 01 y basis members total_weighted_sum_squares and mean_field (raw = centered + n_train * ||mean||_w^2, exact because centered train residuals sum to zero)
metric.val_constants_source: compute-constants phase: exact streamed weighted norms of the validation residual shards (residual_path column); never touches sealed test

production_gates.note: Heavy phases (compute-constants, run-grid) refuse to run unless BOTH gates are open.

purpose: Fit the FINAL max-rank CCA grid in EOF score space on TRAIN scores only, evaluate every valid row on validation full-field area-weighted MSE via the exact orthonormal score-space SSE identity, and select the minimum-validation-MSE row. Train-fit / validation-selected; sealed test untouched. Kx extended to 10592 = n_train - 1 (rank terminus of the centered training data) because both the 20260703 run (Kx=512) and the kx4096 run (Kx=4096, r=512) boundary-selected; r extended to 1024 = Ky_max for the same reason.

safety.atomic_writes: unique temp filename per job/pid/time_ns + os.replace; no shared temp filenames
safety.resume_protocol: done JSON identity strict-equality; mismatched/tampered done JSONs are refused, never silently reused; no config-level output-existence blocker (Stage 02 hygiene lesson)

selection_rule: minimum val_mse_K2; tie-breakers: smaller r, then smaller Kx, then smaller Ky
units_note: Stage 03 scores/residuals are in normalized t2m_tgt units; metric columns with suffix _K/_K2 are legacy normalized values. Physical-K columns are added by the documented unit patch using t2m_tgt std 21.627892139211994 K, identical to the 20260703 convention (selection and skill are scale-invariant).

y_basis.note: Stage 03 only reads the SMALL members total_weighted_sum_squares and mean_field through the 64 MiB size-guarded loader; eofs_weighted is never touched.

y_reuse_note: Y basis and Y train/val scores are REUSED 20260703 artifacts, reached through symlinks under this run's outputs_heavy tree (kx10592); their done-JSON sha256 pins and expected idents are copied verbatim from the completed 20260703 Stage 03 config and re-verified. Provenance: outputs_heavy/REUSE_MANIFEST.json. The expected_ident basis_npz/path strings inside the Y done JSONs intentionally still name the 20260703 scratch tree (the done JSONs are the original files).
